name: sql-prism
description: Visual readability for SQL & dbt: distinct base colors for CTEs, derived shades for inner tables/aliases, CTE scope lines, and semantic data type highlighting.

sqlPrism.cte.enabled.description: Enable coloring for CTEs, inner tables, and parentheses.

enumDescriptions: Bright, high-contrast pastel colors for maximum distinction.
Softer, toned-down colors with clear hue separation.
sqlPrism.cte.colorStyle.description: Color palette style used for CTEs, tables, and aliases.

enumDescriptions: Tables and aliases inside a CTE inherit the exact color of their enclosing CTE.
Tables and aliases inside a CTE receive their own distinct color from the palette, just like in the final SELECT.
sqlPrism.cte.innerTablesMode.description: Coloring behavior for tables and aliases declared inside a CTE.

sqlPrism.cte.showLine.description: Show a subtle vertical line on the left side of each CTE block.

sqlPrism.types.enabled.description: Enable semantic coloring for SQL data types in casts (:: and CAST/TRY_CAST).

commands.title: SQL Prism: Toggle CTE Left Line
